summary: Neff Gaming reviews his Season 8 achievements and transitions back to Server 9 for the start of Season 9: The Undertow Approaches. Season 9 introduces 15+ new heroes, fresh equipment sets, a revamped Season Boss, and the Hydra Temporal Vortex boss. During a 300-dice Targeted Summons session, he pulls Fyrenzur and Tallyn, eventually selecting Longbeau at the 300-summon pity threshold. He also inspects the kit of new Epic hero Quirro, concluding that while Quirro brings shield dispelling and buff transfers, he is nothing particularly special.

heroes.name: Longbeau
heroes.note: Selected at the 300-summon milestone on the Targeted Summons banner to complete the featured Legendary trio.

heroes.name: Fyrenzur
heroes.note: Pulled directly from the Targeted Summons banner as a new Fire support addition.

heroes.name: Tallyn
heroes.note: A new Lightning Fort Commander Legendary pulled during the Targeted Summons pulls.

heroes.name: Quirro
heroes.note: Fire Epic support capable of dispelling enemy shields, stealing enemy buffs to give to the highest Attack ally, and casting Defense Up II, but overall lacks game-changing power.

meta_changes: Season 9 (The Undertow Approaches) adds new gear sets, 15+ new Fire and Lightning heroes, a new Season Boss, and the Hydra boss to Temporal Vortex.
tips: Completing 300 summons on the Targeted Summons banner allows players to pick one guaranteed featured Legendary hero of their choice.
